summary: Decide the standard stakeholder output contract
description: Decision ticket (Grilling/HITL): Which sections and status language must every shareable .go delivery contain so an opdrachtgever can understand outcome, scope, evidence, limitations, open points, and next steps without reading repository internals?
acceptance: A versioned report contract names mandatory and optional sections plus status vocabulary and audience assumptions
The contract separates stakeholder narrative from machine-verifiable provenance
